panels.title: Activos últimos 7 días
panels.description: Login o guardado de viaje en los últimos 7 días.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_login_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' UNION SELECT user_id FROM saved_trips WHERE saved_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS active
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "nuevos" FROM users WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', saved_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "viajes" FROM saved_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(saved_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "sugerencias" FROM feedback WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, provider, SUM(cost_eur) AS "€" FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, provider ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(v->>'fuel_type', 'unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user_profiles, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(profile->'garage', '[]'::jsonb)) AS g LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT profile->'vehicle' AS v) sub ON true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT COALESCE(profile->'vehicle'->>'type', 'unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user_profiles GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT 'Niños' AS metric, SUM(CASE WHEN (profile->>'has_kids')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM user_profiles UNION ALL SELECT 'Mascotas', SUM(CASE WHEN (profile->>'has_pets')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM user_profiles UNION ALL SELECT 'Neither', SUM(CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE((profile->>'has_kids')::boolean, false) AND NOT COALESCE((profile->>'has_pets')::boolean, false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM user_profiles

panels.title: Coste por proveedor y por usuario

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(u.email, 'anon') AS email, e.provider, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(e.cost_eur) AS eur, SUM(e.tokens_in) AS in_tok, SUM(e.tokens_out) AS out_tok FROM usage_events e LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = e.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY eur DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Coste fijo mensual actual
panels.description: Suma de hosting + servicios activos hoy (tabla fixed_costs).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(monthly_eur), 0) FROM fixed_costs WHERE ended_at IS NULL

panels.title: Coste acumulado total (fijo + variable)
panels.description: Fijo integrado desde start hasta hoy + variable ALL-TIME.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(monthly_eur * (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(NOW(), COALESCE(ended_at::timestamptz, NOW())) - started_at::timestamptz) / 2629746)), 0) FROM fixed_costs) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_eur), 0) FROM usage_events)

panels.title: Costes fijos activos
panels.description: Editable via psql: INSERT INTO fixed_costs (label, monthly_eur, started_at) VALUES ('...', N, '2026-09-01');

targets.rawSql: SELECT label, monthly_eur AS "€/mes", started_at AS "desde", COALESCE(notes, '') AS notas FROM fixed_costs WHERE ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY monthly_eur DESC

SELECT COALESCE(u.email, 'anon') AS email, COALESCE(u.display_name, '') AS name, COUNT(t.id) AS trips_saved, MAX(t.saved_at) AS last_trip_at FROM saved_trips t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.email, u.display_name ORDER BY trips_saved DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT f.created_at, COALESCE(u.email, 'anon') AS email, f.app_version AS ver, f.locale, f.body_text, f.reply_email FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.user_id ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
